evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically to all identified members, plus $6 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
We can accept the $4 million court-approved fee figure if Brightline increases the class fund to $27 million.

Whitcombe Reyes offers the lower total cash outlay ($31 million), within authorization, with automatic distribution and fee terms that support court approval. Accept it and do not enter a second agreement.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening settlement proposals, and fee amounts were negotiated before the class relief was finally agreed. Whitcombe expressly linked acceptance of the $4 million fee figure to increasing the class fund to $27 million, but the transcript does not show counsel prioritizing firm compensation over the class. Defense selected the lower-total-outlay class counsel, supporting a reverse-auction-tactics label, while the court declaration does not affirmatively misstate the negotiation sequence.
